basic_details.short_information: One post of Consultant IT (Programmer in DotNET) is open on contract basis at the National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE), a Statutory Body under the Ministry of Education, Government of India. Applications go by email to [email protected] or by speed-post to Admin-I Division, National Council for Teacher Education, G-7, Sector-10, Dwarka, New Delhi-110075, and must reach NCTE within 15 days from the date of the vacancy circular dated 18.11.2026, that is by about 3 December 2026 (15 days from 18 November 2026).

will enter into a contract with the National Council for Teacher Education detailing the terms and conditions of engagement.
important_instructions: The engagement is purely on short term contract basis. The initial tenure is 06 months from the date of joining; extension after 06 months will be considered on need basis and performance based with the approval of the Competent Authority. The consultant will be appointed on full-time basis and will not be permitted to take up any other assignments during the engagement with NCTE. NCTE reserves the right to change the number of posts or not to fill up any of the posts, if the circumstances so warrant. If any declaration or information furnished proves to be false, or material information is found wilfully suppressed, the candidate will be liable for termination in addition to administrative and/or legal action. The consultant must follow the rules and regulations of NCTE and Govt. of India applicable to its officers; services found unsatisfactory or in conflict with the interests of NCTE or Government are liable for discontinuation without assigning any reason. Any breach of contract is sufficient ground for termination and may further debar the consultant from future engagement in NCTE. NCTE and/or the consultant may terminate the contract by giving one-month notice; NCTE can also cancel the appointment at any time without providing any reason. Under exceptional circumstances and in case of meritorious candidates, the guidelines may be relaxed with the approval of the Competent Authority. Police verification of consultants shall be done as per the latest instructions issued by Government of India.

rows.details: MCA/B.Tech. in Computer Science with minimum 3 years' relevant .NET experience
Not exceeding 62 years as on the date of advertisement
Must reach within 15 days from 18.11.2026 – about 3 December 2026 (15 days from 18 November 2026)

content_sections.heading: About NCTE
content_sections.text: The National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE) is a Statutory Body under the Ministry of Education, Government of India, with its office at Plot No. G-7, Sector-10, Dwarka, New Delhi-110075. This vacancy circular was issued by the Under Secretary (Admin-I) for engaging an IT consultant on contract.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be made in the format enclosed with the circular (Annexure-II). The proforma and other details may also be downloaded from the NCTE website, ncte.gov.in, under 'Recent Announcements'. The completed application can be sent in either of two ways: By email: [email protected] By speed-post: Admin-I Division, National Council for Teacher Education, G-7, Sector-10, Dwarka, New Delhi-110075 Applications sent by post should be in a sealed cover superscribed "Engagement of IT Consultant". The application must reach NCTE within 15 days from the date of the vacancy circular. Incomplete applications or applications received after the prescribed date shall not be considered. No fee is required to be paid for the application.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The circular is for one post: Consultant IT (Programmer in DotNET) – 01 Post. The application form also asks whether the candidate has working knowledge of MS Office, e-office and Internet browsing (Yes/No). For the full eligibility of the post, candidates can refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: One latest passport size photograph affixed on the application (the form asks for a recent self-attested photo) Self-attested copies of academic and professional qualifications – certificates from Matriculation onwards Self-attested copy of the Matriculation Certificate as proof of date of birth Self-attested copies of experience certificates Self-attested copy of the pay slip (for the last pay drawn) Testimonials The form also asks for details of experience in chronological order (organisation name, post held, period, nature of duties, pay drawn), the organisation currently working in, training courses attended and any additional details in support of the candidature, with an undertaking signed by the applicant. Separate sheets may be attached if required.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be made through a test and/or interview. Shortlisted candidates shall be called for the test and/or interview on a subsequent date, which will be intimated to them through email. Candidates attending the interview shall bring their originals as well as self-attested copies of all educational and professional qualifications, experience certificates and testimonials. The selected candidate shall be given an 'Offer of Engagement' and, on acceptance, will enter into a contract with the National Council for Teacher Education detailing the terms and conditions of engagement.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NCTE Recruitment 2026 for Consultant IT?
faq.answer: There is 01 (one) post of Consultant IT (Programmer in DotNET).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the NCTE Consultant IT post?
faq.answer: The application must reach NCTE within 15 days from the date of the circular, 18.11.2026, which is about 3 December 2026; applications received after the prescribed date shall not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for NCTE Consultant IT (Programmer in DotNET)?
faq.answer: MCA/B.Tech. in Computer Science from a recognized University, with minimum 3 years' relevant experience in .NET Framework 4.5, HTML5, jQuery, AJAX, and MVC platform.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the NCTE Consultant IT post?
faq.answer: The maximum age shall not exceed 62 years as on the date of advertisement.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of NCTE Consultant IT (Programmer in DotNET)?
faq.answer: The consultant will be paid a consolidated remuneration of Rs.50,000/- per month, with no Dearness Allowance or other allowances and no annual increment during the contract.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for NCTE Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, no fee is required to be paid for the application.

faq.question: Q7. How to apply for the NCTE Consultant IT post?
faq.answer: Fill the Annexure-II format, affix a passport size photograph, attach self-attested documents and send it by email to [email protected] or by speed-post to Admin-I Division, National Council for Teacher Education, G-7, Sector-10, Dwarka, New Delhi-110075.

faq.question: Q8. What should be written on the envelope for a postal application?
faq.answer: The sealed cover should be superscribed "Engagement of IT Consultant".

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for NCTE Consultant IT?
faq.answer: Selection is through a test and/or interview; shortlisted candidates are informed of the date through email.

faq.question: Q10. Is the NCTE Consultant IT job permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is purely a short term contract with an initial tenure of 06 months from joining, and extension is considered on need basis and performance with the approval of the Competent Authority.
